verdict.rationale: Training-data controls are a fair question for an LLM gateway, but nothing in the evidence documents a LiteLLM feature or policy that keeps user data out of model training. The closest item, a switch that stops messages and responses being logged to a logging provider (litellm-docs-12), is an adjacent logging control and does not address training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
